P.name: Second Skin
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Living Weapon:}} '''Kai'Sa''' can evolve each of her {{tip|ability|basic abilities}} by gaining a set amount of permanent [[Champion statistic|stats]] from [[item]]s and {{tt|stat growth|Includes all stats gained when leveling (including base AD gained), but does not include stats at level 1.}}, granting them additional effects. Evolving an ability causes her to enter a 2-second [[cast time]]. The upgrade is lost if the stat requirement is no longer met.
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Plasma:}} '''Kai'Sa's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' apply {{tip|stacks}} of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 5 times. Basic attacks each apply 1 stack and ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' applies 2 stacks, increased to 3 if it is {{ai|Void Seeker 2|Kai'Sa|evolved}}. Her and nearby allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects and {{tip|polymorph|polymorphs}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} will also apply a stack of {{as|Plasma|buzzword}}.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Caustic Wounds:}} {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} stacks applied by '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attacks or ''{{ai|Void Seeker|Kai'Sa}}'' deal {{as|{{pplevel|4 to 30}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} plus {{as|{{pplevel|1 to 8}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} {{as|per Plasma stack before application|buzzword}}, up to a total of {{as|{{pplevel|(4+1*4) to (30+8*4)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12+3*4}}% AP)}} '''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} at {{as|4 Plasma stacks before application|buzzword}}. The fifth stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}} equal to {{as|15% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}}, capped at 400 against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

Q.name: Icathian Rain
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' releases a swarm of 6 missiles that evenly distributes among nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each one hitting their target after {{fd|0.4}} seconds to deal {{as|physical damage}}. {{tip|Minions}} below {{sti|health|{{as|35% health}}}} take double damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Missile|{{ap|40 to 100}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: Non-minions take {{ap|0.25*100}}% damage from missiles beyond their first.
Q.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|dam_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack damage}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100 attack damage}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Icathian Rain'' instead fires 12 missiles.
Q.description4: ''A nearby enemy is required to cast this ability.''

W.name: Void Seeker
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} around its trajectory as it travels, deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, applies {{as|2 Plasma|buzzword}}, and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} them for 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires {{sti|{{as|100 ability power}}}} from [[items]] to upgrade – ''Void Seeker'' applies {{as|3 Plasma|buzzword}} instead and refunds 75% of its {{sti|cooldown}} if it hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}.

E.name: Supercharge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' charges up over the cast time, during which she is still able to move, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and gaining {{sti|ms|{{As|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration, with the effectiveness increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''bonus''' attack speed|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% '''bonus''' attack speed.}}|as}}.
E.leveling: {{st|Minimum Movement Speed|{{ap|55 to 75}}%|Maximum Movement Speed|{{ap|55*2 to 75*2}}%}}
E.description2: After completing the charge, she gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, during which her attacks have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|(0.1/{{ccd|Kai'Sa|attack_total_time}})*100|round=2}}% and an increased missile speed.
E.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Second Skin|Kai'Sa|Evolution}}:}} Requires{{ft|{{sti|as|{{as|{{pplevel|round=ceil|key=%|100-{{ccd|Kai'Sa|as_lvl}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} attack speed}}}} from items|{{sti|{{as|100% attack speed}}}} from items and stat growth}}to upgrade – ''Supercharge'' grants {{tip|invisibility}} at the start of the cast time for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

R.name: Killer Instinct
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kai'Sa''' grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to a target location near a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion that was {{tt|affected|Stack application or consumption}} by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} within the last 4 seconds. The shield's duration is refreshed when the dash ends.
R.description2: ''An enemy champion within range and affected by {{as|Plasma|buzzword}} is required to cast this ability. Killer Instinct {{tip|Basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kai'Sa's''' basic attack timer. '''Kai'Sa''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash.''
